newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices up on speculative buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Thursday rose to 1,145/1,146 rupees per quintal from 1,138/1,139 rupees on fresh speculative buying, dealers said.
"Overseas demand however remained dull but sliding arrivals at producing centres prompted short-covering at the lower level," a dealer said.
Daily arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region fell to 16,000/17,000 bags (75 kg each) against recent average of 20,000/25,000 bags.
"Technically the market is oversold and fresh short-covering may help market to bounce back further," one operator said.

Groundnut oil held steady at 361/362 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes while consumer buying was at a low ebb. Imported palm-oil moved down to 270 rupees per 10 kg from 273 rupees on fresh arrivals at the Bombay port.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose by five rupees at 570/575 rupees per 15 kg amid lower than expected summer crop arrivals following recent unseasonal rains.
